video.title: AI欧腐《男王后的陷阱/The Male Queen's Trap： After I Lied to My Sister's Groom》
video.desc:
剧本一般 建模不错
Austin, the androgynous prince of Valencia, has loved Leo since Leo saved him in his youth. When Leo prepares to marry Austin's sister Stella, a rockslide leaves Stella in a coma—and Austin seizes the chance to stage a soul-possession deception, entering the palace to get closer to him. He forges a blood pact and deliberately provokes Leo, walking the edge between lies and desire. As Queen Flora and minister Zane plot to seize the throne, Austin sacrifices his heart's blood.
Valencia 王国的王子 Austin 拥有一副雌雄莫辨的美丽容貌。自少年时期被 Leo 救下后，他便一直深爱着对方。
然而，Leo 即将迎娶的却是 Austin 的姐姐 Stella。一场突如其来的山体滑坡使 Stella 陷入昏迷，Austin 趁机编造了“灵魂附身”的谎言，假装姐姐的灵魂进入了自己的身体，并以此为借口进入王宫、接近 Leo。
为了让骗局更加真实，Austin 伪造血契，还不断故意挑衅 Leo，在谎言与欲望之间小心游走。可随着两人越走越近，这场始于欺骗的计划，也逐渐变成一张困住 Austin 自己的情网。
与此同时，Flora 王后与大臣 Zane 正密谋夺取王位。为了保护 Leo 与整个王国，Austin 不惜献出自己的心头血。
